records.title: Find work through UWV, EURES and werk.nl
records.description: UWV coordinates the EURES network in the Netherlands and points jobseekers to official job-search support. The available route depends on nationality and residence status; people with a BSN and DigiD can also use werk.nl for vacancies and jobseeker resources.

official_source.title: Working in the Netherlands as an EU/EEA or Swiss national

records.ai_summary: Start with the UWV route matching nationality and work status. Use EURES before moving where appropriate, then use werk.nl after obtaining the credentials it requires; verify work-authorisation rules separately.

attributes.nationality_caveat: Routes differ for EU/EEA/Swiss and other nationals

records.title: Request a Dutch basic payment account
records.description: A consumer who cannot obtain a regular Dutch payment account can check eligibility for a statutory basic payment account or, in specified cases, the Basic Bank Account Covenant route. Banks still apply legal anti-money-laundering checks and may refuse an application on defined grounds.

official_source.title: Wat kan ik als consument doen als ik geen betaalrekening kan krijgen?

records.ai_summary: If a regular account is refused, compare the official basic-account and covenant routes, confirm the current eligibility conditions, keep the written refusal and use the bank complaint process before escalating where appropriate.

attributes.responsible_authority: Ministry of Finance and regulated banks
attributes.fallback_route: Basic Bank Account Covenant may apply in specified cases

records.title: Understand bank identity and customer checks
records.description: Dutch banks must identify customers and assess money-laundering and financial-crime risks. They may request identity and other risk-relevant information, must be able to explain why it is needed, and may decline a customer relationship when risks cannot be managed.
records.ai_summary: Ask the bank which identity or source-of-funds information is required and why, provide accurate evidence through the bank's official channel, and keep the decision and complaint correspondence if an application is refused.
